''See also: [[Riyusai Meira Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Riyusai Meira, also known as Meira, is the keeper of the [[Seishen royal garden]] and holds the rank of [[Underlady]]. Recognized as a genius, she has sworn an oath to protect the first prince of the [[Seishen Kingdom]], whom she helped raise and train. Her combat abilities are characterized by the use of a scythe that carries life-fire, as well as an [[Iron body]] that has been reforged in [[soulfire]]. In battle, she utilizes [[life madra]] to manipulate vines and roots, and can manifest a massive tree of [[life madra]]. She has also been seen wearing sleek armor made of polished wood that glows with green light. Meira's role involves significant service to the Seishen royal family, including tending to their gardens and acting as a protector. Following the death of [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Kiro]], she experienced profound grief and sought vengeance, nearly sacrificing herself in the process. She has also been tasked with receiving [[Seishen Daji]], the surviving heir to the kingdom, after the [[Akura clan]] determined there were no other heirs. Her temperament can shift from a blank, [[The mask|mask]]-like composure to intense fury, particularly when dealing with those she perceives as threats or failures to her royal charges.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This gray-eyed woman has gray hair adorned with pink-flower [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]] over one ear. She wears full armor that conceals green and silver [[Remnant]] parts beneath it.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|An ally to [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Kiro]] and [[Seishen Daji|Daji]], Meira is a loyal [[Underlady]] whose devotion to [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Prince Kiro]] protected her from the wrath of [[King Dakata]]. She is driven by a debt to an unnamed man who provided her training.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Meira is an ally to [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Kiro]] and [[Seishen Daji|Daji]]. She has also engaged in combat with [[Yerin's Blood Shadow]] and threatened the lives of [[Yerin]]'s family and friends. Additionally, she communicates messages from a [[Sage]] to [[King Dakata]] and maintains loyalty to [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Prince Kiro]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A skilled [[life artist]] and [[Underlord]], Meira can conjure [[life madra]] to launch lances of light or bloom into a tree. She utilizes a scythe-blade of [[green flame]], [[sword]] and [[blood]] techniques, and a [[Ruler technique]] to manipulate black roots.}}
